name: Duplicate-Aware, Reproducible Frozen-Feature Benchmark for Brain Tumour MRI Classification on BRISC 2025
description: Data underlying the manuscript “Validation Is Not Enough: A Duplicate-Aware, Reproducible Frozen-Feature Benchmark for Brain Tumour MRI Classification on BRISC 2025”. Contains the perceptual-hash near-duplicate audit of the BRISC 2025 brain tumour MRI collection (1,352 candidate pairs at pHash distance ≤ 4, of which 439 cross the official train/test boundary and 23 carry conflicting labels), the resulting leakage-reduced group-aware split of 5,477 images, per-image test predictions with full class probabilities for three frozen backbones (ResNet-18, ResNet-50, DINOv2 ViT-S/14) across three seeds, and the per-run metrics, group-level bootstrap confidence intervals and calibration bins. The BRISC 2025 images are not redistributed here; that dataset is third-party and publicly available, and each row keys back to it through the image’s path within the official release. See README.md for the file map and MANIFEST.csv for checksums. Data underlying the manuscript “Validation Is Not Enough: A Duplicate-Aware, Reproducible Frozen-Feature Benchmark for Brain Tumour MRI Classification on BRISC 2025”.
